steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p0_member_compare (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, state ENUM('pending','active','closed'), rights SET('read','write','exec')) ENGINE=InnoDB
INSERT INTO p0_member_compare (id, state, rights) VALUES (1, 'pending', 'read'), (2, 'active', 'read,write'), (3, 'closed', 'exec')
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE state = 'active' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE state <> 'active' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE state IN ('pending', 'closed') ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE state > 'active' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE state = 2 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE state = 'gone' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE rights = 'read' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE rights = 'read,write' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM p0_member_compare WHERE rights = 'write,read' ORDER BY id
